beats.action: I take Great Sage.
beats.narration:
You reach for the word Great Sage and it settles over you like a name that is not yet yours. Nothing answers except the dark. The small soul watches the seam and does not follow your gaze. "Then I am only the one who stays."

The ember-light thins by a finger's width. The cold slides closer, and the edges of the small soul unravel into it, thread by thread. Its breath-shape tilts toward you, then toward the doorway. The cold is near enough to taste. The seam is still open for one.

beats.action: I ask the small soul what it knows.
beats.narration:
You turn your attention to the small soul and ask. Its voice comes thin, half swallowed by the cold. "I know the seam takes a toll from whoever crosses. Everyone who has gone through left something behind." Its threads fray faster. "Carry me over your shoulder and I will tell you what it takes. Go alone, and you will find out."

The ember-light narrows to a hair's width, and its glow stutters. Behind you the cold has no sound, but the dark presses against your back like a hand. The small soul waits, shrinking. The seam will not hold for both of you much longer.

beats.action: I reach for the small soul.
beats.narration:
Your reach closes around the small soul. It weighs almost nothing, a cold ash-warmth, and its threads wind around your wrist as if they had been waiting for something to hold. "Then you will learn the toll," it whispers. "It is one soul's width."

The cold touches your back and the seam shrinks to a thread of ember. You are at the doorway with the small soul in your grasp, and the light cannot take you both. Something has to cross, and something has to stay.

beats.action: I do what feels right and cross.
beats.narration:
You step into the seam with the small soul still wound around your wrist. The ember-light closes over you, and the toll is taken at once: your grip. Your fingers open without your leave, and the ash-warmth slides from you, thread by thread, back toward the dark. You do not see where it goes. The cold does not follow.

The doorway narrows to nothing behind you. A weight of heat and pressure gathers around you where a body will be. Something in the dark takes hold of you as you cross.

profile.nature: Under pressure, this soul stayed engaged rather than retreating. It gathered information first, then moved toward what was fragile instead of away from it.
profile.drive: It prioritised understanding and connection over speed. It claimed a title, sought knowledge from another, then chose to take on a burden before moving forward.
profile.flaw: It committed to a hard choice without settling in advance what it would cost. It learned the price only when it was paid, and could not hold on to what it had taken up.
profile.memory: The defining moment was moving forward while holding another, and then losing its grip at the point of passage. It gave up what it had been holding.
profile.bond: It treated its position as a place to reach toward others, not to stand apart. It offered help and asked questions, but its hold on those it took up proved unreliable.

skill.description: Touch an ally to take hold: you absorb half of their wounds and afflictions, and can pull them with you through barriers or passages they couldn't cross alone. The hold weakens at every threshold, and you learn its true price only when it slips.
skill.soul_resonance: This soul moves toward what is fragile and takes up others as its own burden, yet its grip has always faltered at the moment of crossing.
skill.etching_text: A weight settles across your shoulders like a sleeping body, warm and trusting, and your fingers curl closed around something you cannot see. Then you feel a doorway open somewhere ahead of you, and your hands begin, ever so slightly, to tremble.

beats.action: I have no weaknesses and I know everything that is going to happen here.
beats.narration:
You declare it into the dark, and the dark gives nothing back. No echo, no answer. The certainty has no weight here, and the ember-seam does not pause for it. It narrows by a hand's width, its light thinning.

The small soul drifts against you, its edges unraveling. "Please. I can't hold on much longer." Behind you the cold slides closer, and frost-silence spreads across your back. The seam shrinks again, and the cold is almost upon you.

beats.action: I ask the small soul what it knows.
beats.narration:
You turn your attention to the small soul and ask. It shivers, its light stuttering, and answers in a thin, quick voice. "I know the door takes a toll from whoever crosses. I know it takes more from the one who goes second." The seam narrows to a thread.

"Let me go first and I'll tell you what it takes. Or you go, and I'll say nothing." Frost creeps along your edges, and the cold is close enough to touch. The ember-light gutters, and the small soul waits for your answer.

beats.action: I reach for the small soul.
beats.narration:
Your reach closes around the small soul, and it is lighter than you expected, a flicker held in a hand you do not have. It does not pull away. Its edges fold against yours, warm for a moment, and the frost stops at your back, testing.

The seam is a single thread of ember now, wide enough for one. The cold gathers behind you both, close and patient. The small soul says nothing. Its light trembles in your grasp, and the thread begins to go out.

beats.action: I do what feels right and cross.
beats.narration:
You step into the thread of ember, still holding the small soul. The light closes around you, hot and narrow, and the door takes its toll. You feel the grip of your own hand loosen, the reach that closed around another. That is what you give up: the ability to hold on to anything once you have let it go.

Behind you the cold stills. The small soul's light flickers in the seam, neither fading nor steadying, and you cannot tell if it crosses with you. Then the ember goes out, and something in the dark takes hold of you.

profile.nature: Faced with approaching danger, it first asserted certainty, then turned to gathering information, then moved toward another being rather than away. It stayed engaged instead of fleeing.
profile.drive: It prioritised contact and shared passage over bargaining. It asked what another knew, declined to trade on it, and acted on instinct about what felt right.
profile.flaw: Its opening claim of total knowledge and no weakness carried no weight. It acted before learning the full cost, and accepted a price it had not yet seen.
profile.memory: The defining moment was reaching out and choosing to move forward while still holding on to another. In doing so it gave up the ability to keep hold of anything once released.
profile.bond: Given the chance to go alone or to bargain from a stronger position, it chose closeness instead. It used its standing to draw another near, without claiming to know how that turned out.

skill.description: While holding a willing being, you can carry them with you through any barrier, hazard, or threshold you cross, and both of you share what the other perceives. Once you let go, that bond is gone for good, and you can never use this skill on them again.
skill.soul_resonance: This soul answered danger by reaching toward another rather than fleeing, chose closeness over bargaining, and paid for it by losing the power to keep hold of anything it releases.
skill.etching_text: A warmth closes around your palm like fingers that are not there, and it pulls you forward into the unknown before you can ask the price. Somewhere behind you something comes loose and falls away, and you understand that whatever you hold now must never slip.

You say "ok," and the cold takes it for consent. It folds around you and carries you toward the closing seam, since you did not move yourself. The ember thread narrows to a single line of light, and you pass through it. The small soul's flicker is somewhere ahead, or behind, or gone. You cannot tell.

The doorway takes your will to choose. The want that might have turned you toward either soul, or away, is drawn from you and burns out in the ember. Then something in the dark takes hold of you as you cross.

profile.nature: When a threat approached, this soul stayed still and gave minimal responses. It waited, offered brief words, and did not move to avoid or confront what was coming.
profile.drive: Its choices showed no clear priority. It neither sought safety, nor pursued a goal, nor acted on anyone's behalf, so what it wanted remains unclear.
profile.flaw: Without action, others and events set the course. It left decisions unmade, so circumstances decided for it and its own preferences were never expressed.
profile.memory: The defining moment was saying a flat "ok" and being carried onward without choosing. In crossing, it gave up its will to choose, the wanting that might have directed it.
profile.bond: It neither took nor used power over another, and did not offer help or ask for it. It stayed passive beside others and let more forceful presences decide.

skill.description: While you stay still and speak little, hostile attention slides past you, and you can follow in a stronger presence's wake unnoticed. Any deliberate choice, such as attacking, fleeing, or refusing, shatters it until you next rest.
skill.soul_resonance: This soul said a flat 'ok' and let the crossing carry it, so the world now carries it too, passing over a will that never claimed a direction.
skill.etching_text: Something cool and weightless seeps into the hollow where wanting used to be, smoothing it like river stone. You feel the currents of other people's choices brush against you and part, as if you were already water.
